house_v1: values.dsr_house_v1.v8 (N = construction count by ledger_n, V = dsr_variance of the window's construction lines; K-P9-5 dsr.house_v1); values.dsr_house_v1.tot is the total-count row

cbb_starts.rule: numpy default_rng(20260929).integers(0, 500, size=(4999, 24)); index (start + j) mod T, j < 21, first 500 kept

onc_picks.rule: backtest_integrity.kmeans draws in call order: [integers, n, pick] seeds the first center, [choice, n, pick] each next k-means++ center (p = d^2 / sum d^2); onc runs n_init 10 x k = 2..N-1, then its recursion, on one generator (default_rng(20260927))

series.recipe:
T x K daily returns: 3 groups of 4 trials on a shared group factor, Student-t(5) idiosyncratic noise (fat
    tails, so skewness and kurtosis matter), drifts rising with the trial index (distinct SRs).

dsr_cross.reason: moments, the ddof-1 variance of the SRs and norm_ppf

dsr_house_v1.reason: N and the cell counts are integers (tie at 0); V divides s2_net_sr by sqrt(252) and takes a ddof-1 variance (numpy), SR0 uses norm_ppf

moments.reason: numpy mean / std use pairwise summation; an engine sequential sum differs in the last bits

norm_ppf.reason: Python bisects norm_cdf to 1e-15 relative; the engine uses Acklam plus one Halley step (eval/stats_ext.hpp): equal to rounding, not to the bit

onc.reason: given the recorded picks, n_eff and the clusters are exact; variance_sr, cluster SRs and the correlation mean 1e-12 (numpy corrcoef and moments)

onc_replay.reason: clusters exact given the picks; silhouettes 1e-12 (pairwise distances)

paired.reason: Memmel SE, rho and the SRs from numpy moments; with the committed CBB starts the resamples are exact, the bootstrap SRs and LW sums 1e-12; the p-values and valid-draw counts are integer ratios (0 unless a studentized draw sits within rounding of its threshold)

pbo.reason: pbo, splits, winner_counts and the OOS rank histogram are integer counts: 0 while pbo_margins stay far above rounding; logit_mean, quantiles, means and the slope 1e-12 (matrix products on block sums)

psr.reason: moments' summation order, and norm_cdf via erfc in both; MinTRL adds norm_ppf (below)
